name: Slagtree's Lost Tools
summary: Slagtree’s Lost Tools are a stolen set of smithing tools sought by Smith Slagtree in Revantusk Village. Their value to him comes from the gnome who gave them to him long ago.

sections.title: A Stolen Gift
sections.body: At Revantusk Village, Smith Slagtree asks you to search for the tools taken when Vilebranch trolls invaded. He keeps a backup set, but these tools were given to him by a kind-hearted gnome who saved his life when he was young. They may lie near the Agol'watha or Shaol'watha temples, or at Skulk Rock. Slagtree wants this old gift returned.

faq.answer: Smith Slagtree of Revantusk Village wants his stolen tools returned.

faq.q: Why do the tools matter to Slagtree?
faq.answer: A kind-hearted gnome gave the tools to Slagtree after saving his life when he was a young orc.
Vilebranch trolls stole Slagtree's tools when they invaded Revantusk Village.
The tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples in the northeastern Hinterlands. Slagtree also suggests checking Skulk Rock.
Slagtree has a backup set, but the stolen tools are precious because they came from the gnome who saved his life.

angles.text: A gnome gave Slagtree the tools after saving his life when he was a young orc. Their gift remains precious to the smith.
Slagtree remembers the tools as a gift from the gnome who saved his life when he was a young orc.
